## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the problem and the user-visible result. Link an issue if relevant.

## Validation

List commands actually run and their results. State which checks were not run.
Use synthetic data; do not attach real Hubstaff captures, account identifiers or database files.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Public documentation, code and comments are in English; UI text uses localization resources.
- [ ] Existing data, identifiers, migrations and cancellation/shutdown behavior are preserved.
- [ ] Any privacy, network, dependency or licensing changes are documented.
- [ ] No personal data, model downloads, internal plans or generated build files are included.
